comparison.objective: Hook a laryngoscope blade onto a handle and swing it into its lit detent; candidate separates finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Small hinge-bar engagement, regrasping and rotational latching versus bimanual screen manipulation and granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Blade hooked, swung to 90°, lit/clicked, scope released on tray and still for 1 s; candidate requires complete loading, ≥98% recovery, all washers retained and no loss. The task declares a pose-constrained hinge effect, but its rubric remains clear.
comparison.reason: Hook-and-detent assembly is physically different from selective aperture passage and bridge clearing.
